item.title: 52-year-old back strained from holding off AARP
item.description: A 52-year-old writer feels new back pain unloading beef, finds AARP circling, and reflects with humor on aging, low-key birthdays, kittens and the small aches of midlife.

item.title: A humble career with a big impact
item.description: For 40 years, Doris Hoy kept Mower County’s foster care system and “computer stuff” running, quietly guiding about 300 families through sensitive, life-changing moments.

item.title: Already derailed on your New Year’s resolution?
item.description: Most New Year’s resolutions stall by February—fewer than 10% succeed. Here’s how to reset your goals now with smaller steps, support and realistic targets.

item.title: Woman charged with theft of $84K from Thompson Sanitation while working as administrative assistant
item.description: Former Thompson Sanitation assistant accused of stealing $84K through payroll schemes, faces felony theft, forgery and tax evasion charges.

item.title: Minnesota DNR proposes harvest limits for native rough fish
item.description: Minnesota DNR proposes daily limits and new protections for native rough fish species and is taking public comments on the rules through March 12.

item.title: Betty Corrine Klaehn
item.description: Betty Corrine Klaehn, age 86, of Austin, Minnesota, passed away on Monday, January 12, 2026 at the Cedars of Austin. Betty was born to Willis and Bonnie Danielson on June 17, 1939 in Dows, Iowa. She grew up in the Elkton area and attended Elkton schools graduating with the Class of 1957. On October 17, 1958, she married her high school sweetheart, Kenneth Wilbur Klaehn. Together they shared more than 65 years of marriage and devoted themselves to raising their six children. item.title: Franklin Howard Vorlicek
item.description: Franklin “Frank” Howard Vorlicek, age 80, of Blooming Prairie, Minnesota, passed away on Saturday, January 31, 2026, at Prairie Manor Care Center in Blooming Prairie. Frank was born on May 20, 1945, to Howard and MaryAnn (Urban) Vorlicek in Hutchinson, Minnesota. He attended high school in Silver Lake, Minnesota, graduating as valedictorian of his class in 1963. item.title: Kathryn Mary Roof
item.description: Kathryn “Kady” Mary Roof, age 64, of LeRoy, Minnesota, passed away peacefully Sunday, January 25, 2026. She was surrounded by her loved ones at the time. item.title: Bittersweet Symphony: Rebels show their worth, but can’t close out No. 3 ranked NRHEG
item.description: Southland girls let a 16-point lead slip in a 58-57 loss to No. 3 NRHEG, but double-doubles from Koenigs and Matheis show the Rebels can contend with top-ranked foes.

item.title: PHOTOS: GOP, DFL head to local caucuses Tuesday night
item.description: Photos capture Minnesota caucus night as Austin’s DFL gathers at Ruby Rupner Auditorium and GOP supporters meet at Ellis Middle School and in Grand Meadow.
